kpis.description_fr: ASV = run-rate subscription. Métrique principale FactSet (Bloomberg / Refinitiv competitor). Recurring 90%+.
kpis.description_en: ASV = subscription run-rate. Main FactSet metric (Bloomberg / Refinitiv competitor). 90%+ recurring.

kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de clients FactSet (institutions financières, asset managers, banques, corporate). Base d'utilisateurs structurellement croissante.
kpis.description_en: Total FactSet client count (financial institutions, asset managers, banks, corporates). Structurally growing user base.

kpis.description_fr: Nombre d'utilisateurs nommés Workstation (analyst seats). Métrique volume directement liée aux licences et au revenu.
kpis.description_en: Named Workstation users (analyst seats). Volume metric directly tied to licenses and revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Taux de rétention ASV (basé sur dollars). Stable autour de 95% sur 5 ans, indicateur de stickiness des terminaux financiers (haut switching cost).
kpis.description_en: ASV dollar-based retention. Stable around 95% over 5 years, indicator of financial terminal stickiness (high switching costs).

kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle GAAP. Profitabilité best-in-class data providers, scalability du modèle subscription.
kpis.description_en: GAAP operating margin. Best-in-class data provider profitability, subscription model scalability.

kpis_story.description_fr: FactSet Mercury (LLM copilot pour workflows). Premier release 2024. Premium monetization premium tier ($1500-2000+/user/an).
kpis_story.description_en: FactSet Mercury (LLM copilot for workflows). First 2024 release. Premium tier monetization ($1500-2000+/user/year).

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisition Idaciti 2024 (XBRL data). Expansion private markets data (PitchBook competitor). Pivot growth alpha vs public markets mature.
kpis_story.description_en: Idaciti 2024 acquisition (XBRL data). Private markets data expansion (PitchBook competitor). Growth alpha pivot vs mature public markets.

_notes: FDS = FactSet, financial data + workstation provider (vs Bloomberg, Refinitiv, S&P Capital IQ). Modèle recurring + AI copilot pivot.
